WildcardMode::ComponentScoped. A wildcard in the root component: both readings select it.
WildcardMode::SeparatorCrossing. A wildcard in the root component: both readings select it.
WildcardMode::ComponentScoped. The difference itself: crossing selects a nested file, component scoping does not.
WildcardMode::SeparatorCrossing. The difference itself: crossing selects a nested file, component scoping does not.
WildcardMode::ComponentScoped. Crossing spans any number of separators, not just one.
WildcardMode::SeparatorCrossing. Crossing spans any number of separators, not just one.
WildcardMode::ComponentScoped. A literal prefix holds under both; only what follows it reaches further.
WildcardMode::SeparatorCrossing. A literal prefix holds under both; only what follows it reaches further.
WildcardMode::ComponentScoped. Crossing does not loosen a literal prefix, which is what keeps pruning sound.
WildcardMode::SeparatorCrossing. Crossing does not loosen a literal prefix, which is what keeps pruning sound.
WildcardMode::ComponentScoped. A wildcard component swallows several under crossing.
WildcardMode::SeparatorCrossing. A wildcard component swallows several under crossing.
WildcardMode::ComponentScoped. A wildcard sharing a component with a literal selects beyond that literal in both.
WildcardMode::SeparatorCrossing. A wildcard sharing a component with a literal selects beyond that literal in both.
